tasks.title: Durable worker and cross-turn execution
tasks.goal: Leased worker resumes one AI loop safely under budgets and authorization
tasks.scope_hint: lib/ai/supervisor/runs/*; new worker route; usage adapter

architecture_approval.owner_direction: Proceed with next real PR without a separate E2/testing-only gate; fix failures as they appear

contract.source: Existing authenticated Supervisor run scope (businessId, ownerUserId, threadId), idempotent requestKey, ordered StepSpecs and canonical existing AI loop. No model-provided business identities.
contract.persisted: Reuse existing supervisor_runs and supervisor_run_steps through PR5 repository and fenced lease RPCs, keyed by scoped requestKey and runId:stepKey. Keep only checkpoint keys/status/result references; do not store prompts, replies, secrets or POS rows.
contract.consumer: One bounded worker resumes existing loop through the PR5 runner, checkpoints progress, respects usage/time budgets, and reports an existing verified final report reference. New cron route must be gated and off by default until authorized.
contract.failures: Two workers cannot complete same fenced step. Uncertain non-idempotent effects require verified receipt, not blind replay. Pause/cancel, tenant authorization and per-run budgets are required.
contract.scope: Only the exact exclusive_files above. Any new SQL migrations, other routes, production deployment, permissions or scope changes need separate review.

acceptance: Two workers cannot claim the same step
Restart resumes after verified earlier steps without repeating effects
Timeout/budget/cancel retains a truthful persisted status
